lemmas.primary_translation: well known and accepted / made clear / approved

definitions.text: som er allment kjent og akseptert
definitions.translation: which is generally known and accepted (lit. read aloud and adopted)

examples.no: denne praksisen er for lengst opplest og vedtatt
examples.en: This practice has long since been approved.

examples.no: at han er den beste fotballspilleren er vel opplest og vedtatt
examples.en: That he is the best football player is surely well established.
